sdkAndAdapters.note: The final batch's first native codegen attempt refused the output directory left by the initial batch (exit 2 before compiling); that attempt was preserved and the rerun into a fresh directory passed.

limits: View pointermove listeners only (hit target and its parent), with both original EventTarget flags enabled, under touch drags and button-less mouse motion.
Admitted but uncertified: through the shared root path a Document/documentElement pointermove listener now qualifies any move in its surface; the flag matrix is untested.

Move lookup faults cannot be injected (fault bootstraps accept offsets 34-37 only); the diagnostic boundary holds for 1/25 by construction, and a throwing Move lookup would add one diagnostic per sample, hover included, to an unbounded list.
When no prop qualifies, each move makes two JSI lookups per path node, each resolving the newest clone; the per-move cost is unmeasured.
The host flushes RN's event queue after every input event, so RN's unique-move coalescing is unreachable; per-frame merging comes from Godot input accumulation.
Moves that hit no View, captured ones included, are enqueued as non-unique Unspecified events (Discrete without a ContinuousStart), unlike RN; this predates the slice.
Hover events, pointer capture, captured/no-hit moves, pointerrawupdate, responders/PanResponder, multi-touch, the fixed priority mapping, hardware, mobile exports and performance remain open.
